title: Step 10 — read the agreed terms back before locking any value
description: The full agreement record, wrapped in a singular agreement key. Both banks read this to confirm the terms their HTLC legs must match: 5,000,000 CRC to CR_AGENT on spoke-crc, 37,000 PEN to PE_BENE on spoke-pen.
notes: Gateway: either side. BLOCKING DIVERGENCE, verified in the delivered gateway (fxAgreementToResult calls ag.State.String() on the protobuf enum): state comes back as FX_STATE_ACCEPTED, not the ACCEPTED that both the platform OpenAPI document and contracts/pvp declare in their enum. A client switching on ACCEPTED never matches. group_id and contract_address are present only when Pente integration is active. No field of this record is declared required by the platform.
